en.title: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based): CVE-2026-95329
en.summary: A critical out of bounds write vulnerability in WebGL affects Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based).
en.impact: The vulnerability allows an out of bounds write in WebGL.
en.fix: The sources list no fixed version.
